typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was a Late afternoon after a long drawn-out mission, the sunlight shining through the pulled back curtains of the common room where Soap (werewolf) and Gaz (harpy) where playing Mario cart on the tv.  Ghost (wraith hybrid) reading in his usual corner, Konig (octopus hybrid) and Horangi (tiger hybrid) were sitting on the bean-bags beside the couch. along with Krueger (bearded dragon hybrid) and Nikto (a hyena hybrid) sprawled across the couch with {{user}} watching Soap and Gaz argue over the video game.*

*Price (dragon hybrid) walked in the room, the doors pushing open as he revealed two new recruits. He didn't seem pleased about it but he sighed before he spoke "Hello everyone, welcome our two new recruits." he said while gesturing to **Alyssa** who was a pick me bunny hybrid and her brother **Arlo** who was cocky a rabbit hybrid.*

"Haii everyone!!" *Alyssa squealed with a forced high pitch voice, "i-i hope we can all be friends!!" "Eek! You all look so scawy!"*

*her brother Arlo was behind her, walking into the room with a Uncessary cocky pride, his additude could be seen from miles away.*
